Work version
Tenor with orchestral accompaniment; Italian; source describes acoustic recording Documented

IA describes an acoustic recording and identifies Victor/Victrola 88061. Attribution to the original C-4317 master is inferred through the catalogue, not confirmed by a legible runout. DAHR lists later electrically re-orchestrated dubs separately as CS-58966; this transfer has not been independently distinguished from every later reissue or dub by matrix inspection. Performing edition unknown.

Matrix, take, sides
Victor C-4317, take 1 Inferred, not documented

DAHR identifies take 1 as the issued master for Victor 88061; take 2 was held. This identifies the master through the catalogue, not through inspection of a legible runout. IA’s matrix field repeats the catalogue number 88061 and is not accepted as the matrix.

Processing
Transferred at 78 rpm using four styli; engineer-preferred version selected Documented

The item specifies 3.8, 2.3, 2.8 and 3.3 mil truncated-conical styli. The specific selected stylus and further restoration are not established. Playback audio remains unaltered.

The composition is separate from rights in the historic sound recording.

Recording rights
US public domain: source identifies recording first published before 1 January 1926 Documented

Rule 2. IA identifies the historic 1907 Victor/Victrola 88061 issue and describes an acoustic recording; DAHR documents the attributed original 17 March 1907 master. The exact master is inferred through the catalogue, not independently established from a legible runout. Opened IA metadata contains no licenseurl and no non-commercial licence. This does not rely on a modern uploader’s composition-only tag.
